# Mumla for Mac 1.0.1 (39) - Chromium Paste Confirmation Beta
## Fixed
- Recognize successful auto-pastes into empty Chromium/Electron rich-text fields that report their initial text as a newline. Previously the text could be inserted while Mumla still showed the copy fallback. - Once the complete inserted text is confirmed, the bottom recorder dismisses and the original clipboard is restored. Unchanged fields, partial text and unrelated changes are not accepted as successful pastes. - Thanks to @ehsanYazdani for [PR #2](https://github.com/simonbromander/Mumla/pull/2).
Includes build 38's Show Copy dialog setting: turn it off to copy blocked or unconfirmed dictations to the clipboard without showing a copy panel. Newer user copies are protected. There is no automatic paste retry. History, Paste Last Transcript and Recent Transcripts remain the recovery paths.
Local formatting, summary previews and style preferences from build 37 remain experimental. They require a compatible Mac with macOS 26 and Apple Intelligence enabled and ready. Review generated previews before using them.
## Install
Choose Check for Updates in the direct Mac app, or download this release's notarized ZIP, quit Mumla and replace the copy in Applications. Keep Microphone, Input Monitoring and Accessibility permissions enabled. Do not run direct and TestFlight copies simultaneously.
This is a direct Mac beta for macOS 14 or later, on Apple silicon and Intel. iOS and the sandboxed Mac TestFlight build are unchanged by this release. The app source is public under MIT; model and library licenses remain separate.
## Testing
Try an empty message field and a field with existing text in your actual Chromium/Electron app. After a successful paste, check that the bottom bar disappears, the text appears once and the prior clipboard is restored. Also check blocked paste, secure input, changed focus and newer clipboard copies.
Automated verification does not establish real target-app acceptance, physical hotkey delivery, live update installation or Swedish model quality. Swedish dictation only; English ASR, meetings and iCloud sync are not implemented.

# Mumla for Mac 1.0.1 (38) - Silent Clipboard Fallback Beta
## New
- Mac Settings > Show Copy dialog can now be switched off. Failed, blocked or unverified auto-pastes then copy the transcript to the clipboard and dismiss the bottom recorder, without a transcript/copy dialog. Paste manually with Cmd+V. - Successful auto-pastes still restore the original clipboard and hide the bar. There is no automatic retry that could duplicate text. - A newer clipboard copy made during or after insertion is protected. If Mumla cannot safely copy, the transcript remains in History and the menu-bar status says why. Paste Last Transcript and Recent Transcripts remain available. - Switching the setting off also copies and dismisses an already-open fallback. The setting is saved locally and existing users keep the dialog-enabled default.
Includes build 37's local formatting and separate summary previews, editable style preferences, and recent-transcript menu. Apple Intelligence features need a compatible Mac with macOS 26 and Apple Intelligence enabled and ready. Their real Swedish output quality is still experimental; review previews before use.
## Install
Use Check for Updates in the direct Mac app, or download the notarized ZIP from this release, quit Mumla and replace the copy in Applications. In Mac Settings, switch off Show Copy dialog / Visa kopieringsruta to enable silent fallback.
Keep Microphone, Input Monitoring and Accessibility permissions enabled. Do not run the direct and TestFlight copies simultaneously. Dictation supports macOS 14 or later. iOS and the sandboxed Mac TestFlight build are unchanged by this release.
## Testing
Check successful paste, failed paste, no focused field, secure input, and clipboard restoration in your actual editor. Confirm no copy dialog appears with the setting off and the transcript is available for manual pasting or in History. Automated tests do not establish physical hotkey, target-app or model-quality acceptance.
Swedish dictation only. Meetings, English ASR and iCloud sync are not implemented.

# Mumla for Mac 1.0.1 (37) - Local Text Beta
## New
- Optional on-device formatting in transcript details: preview punctuation, capitalization and paragraphs, accept explicitly, or restore the original. - Optional Summary preview, saved separately from the transcript. Copy and share a saved summary without replacing or pasting over the original text. - Settings > Text preferences: local formatting and summary style prompts, with Save, Cancel and Reset. Formatting still preserves every original word. - Confirmed auto-pastes dismiss the floating bar. Readable editors with delayed acknowledgement get a brief observation-only recheck, never a duplicate paste. - Menu-bar Paste Last Transcript and the ten newest Recent Transcripts.
## Requirements and Limitations
Formatting and summaries require macOS 26 and a compatible Mac with Apple Intelligence enabled and ready. Dictation still supports macOS 14 or later. There is no cloud fallback or additional downloaded text model. Formatting is limited to 1,500 characters; summary input to 6,000. Nothing is silently truncated.
Review summary suggestions before accepting, especially names, dates, quantities and commitments. Swedish summary quality is still experimental. These actions do not run in the dictation hotkey path. Failed or unverifiable pastes retain the manual Copy fallback. Unit tests do not prove physical cross-app behavior.
Swedish dictation only. Meetings, English ASR and iCloud sync are not implemented.
## Install
Use Check for Updates in the existing direct Mac app, or download the notarized ZIP from this release, quit Mumla and replace the copy in Applications. Keep Microphone, Input Monitoring and Accessibility permissions enabled. Do not run the TestFlight and direct copies at the same time.
Please test hotkey release, clipboard restoration and bar dismissal in your actual editor, then try Paste Last Transcript from the menu. This remains a beta.
